svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Anatomy of a Smith chart
svg.desc: A Smith chart: the unit circle of the reflection coefficient, with circles of constant normalised resistance r and arcs of constant normalised reactance x. The short circuit is at the far left, the open circuit at the far right and the matched point at the centre. Inductive loads lie in the upper half and capacitive loads in the lower half. A load of 25 + j50 ohms on a 50 ohm line, z = 0.5 + j1, sits where the r = 0.5 circle meets the x = +1 arc, with a dashed VSWR circle of radius 0.62 through it. An arrow round the rim shows that moving toward the generator turns clockwise.
